rows.commentary: 0.1: Arshad Khan finds immediate swing through the air, curving it down the leg side, where Mitchell Owen misses his flick off the pads and it races past Prabhsimran Singh's despairing dive to the boundary for four leg byes.
0.2: Mitchell Owen does not score off Arshad Khan.
0.3: Arshad Khan floats it up, and Mitchell Owen launches it high and handsome, clearing long-off with absolute disdain for a maximum.
0.4: Arshad Khan angles it full and forces it back into middle, prompting Mitchell Owen forward to drive hard and straight into the hands at mid-on.
0.5: Arshad Khan floats it full and shaping back, but Mitchell Owen leans forward, presents the full face, and lofts it cleanly wide of mid-on to race away for four.
0.6: Arshad Khan goes full and wide outside off, drawing a flashing drive from Mitchell Owen that picks out the fielder at backward point to wrap up a strong start for Australia A.
1.1: Yash Thakur hurls it short of a length outside off, and Sam Konstas slashes it wide of backward point to race away in style.
1.2: No run for Sam Konstas off Yash Thakur.
1.3: Yash Thakur drops it full outside off, and Sam Konstas leans forward to cream a gorgeous drive wide of the diving cover for four.
1.4: Yash Thakur bangs this one short of a length just outside off, and Sam Konstas moves back to punch it hard straight to cover-point.
1.5: Yash Thakur serves it full on off, and Sam Konstas gets forward to tap it wide of mid-off for a comfortable single.
1.6: Yash Thakur strikes in the powerplay, finding the edge of Mitchell Owen who departs for ten after a sharp catch behind by Prabhsimran Singh.

2.1: Arshad Khan angles one away on a length outside off, drawing a forward prod from Sam Konstas whose thick outside edge flies past the desperate dive of the lone slip fielder to race away for four.
2.2: Arshad Khan pushes it full outside off, inviting Sam Konstas forward to unleash a crisp drive that cannons straight into the hands of the cover-point fielder.
2.3: Sam Konstas does not score off Arshad Khan.
2.4: Arshad Khan drops it back of a length on middle, and Sam Konstas rides the crease to work it down to mid-wicket for a single.
2.5: Arshad Khan serves it full and wide, drawing a stretching drive from Josh Philippe that takes a thick outside edge and bounces safely away to third man.
2.6: Arshad Khan digs it in short of a length on off, Sam Konstas punches firmly toward cover, eyes a quick single, but smartly aborts the run.
3.1: Yash Thakur spears it full outside off, and Josh Philippe strides forward to punch it straight to cover-point.
3.2: Dot ball from Yash Thakur to Josh Philippe.
3.3: Yash Thakur delivers full outside off to Josh Philippe, who creams the drive, but Gaikwad launches to his right at mid-off to brilliantly claw back three runs with a sprawling stop.
3.4: Yash Thakur rolls out a slower-ball off-cutter on off, met with a forward defensive prod straight out to mid-off.
3.5: Yash Thakur strikes with precision as Sam Konstas chips it straight to Rajat Patidar, ending a brisk fourteen-run cameo peppered with three boundaries.
3.6: Yash Thakur digs it in short, rising sharply to force Nathan McSweeney back into his crease to fend it cleanly toward the cover region.
4.1: Arshad Khan lands it on a probing good length outside off, drawing Josh Philippe forward to smother the ball solidly toward mid-off.
4.2: Arshad Khan finds the breakthrough as Josh Philippe miscues it straight into the hands of Devdutt Padikkal.
4.3: Arshad Khan angles it full and into the leg-stump, catching Liam Scott with a closed face as a thick leading edge rolls harmlessly toward mid-off.
4.4: Arshad Khan pitches this one full outside off, inviting Liam Scott forward to drive straight to the waiting fielder at cover.
4.5: Dot ball from Arshad Khan to Liam Scott.
4.6: Arshad Khan steams in and fires it down, clipped away by Liam Scott toward backward square leg to comfortably hustle through for a sharp couple of runs.
5.1: Yash Thakur targets the channel outside off, and Nathan McSweeney hops back to dead-bat it straight into the hands of backward point.
5.2: Yash Thakur probes full and just outside off, defended solidly into the cover region by Nathan McSweeney.
5.3: Yash Thakur angles it into the pads, flicked expertly wide of mid-wicket by Nathan McSweeney for a couple of runs.
5.4: Yash Thakur digs in the short effort ball outside off, leaving Nathan McSweeney swinging and missing at the pull.
5.5: Yash Thakur concedes a single as Nathan McSweeney guides the ball down to third man.
5.6: Yash Thakur digs this back of a length right into the channel of the stumps, and Liam Scott gets right behind it, punching a crisp defensive block straight to mid-on.
6.1: Nathan McSweeney does not score off Arshad Khan.
6.2: No run for Nathan McSweeney off Arshad Khan.
6.3: Arshad Khan lands it on a good length outside off, keeping surprisingly low as Nathan McSweeney slashes wildly and watches the delivery sneak straight underneath his bat.
6.4: Arshad Khan offers up the half-volley and Nathan McSweeney punches it with immaculate placement wide of cover, racing away to the rope for four.
6.5: Arshad Khan strays again, and Nathan McSweeney guides it down expertly toward third man for another boundary.
6.6: Arshad Khan keeps it tight and short on off, punched briskly off the back foot by Nathan McSweeney to the left of cover for a sharp single.
7.1: Suryansh Shedge strays way outside off, tempting Nathan McSweeney into a sprawling cut before the umpire rightly signals it wide.
7.1: Suryansh Shedge delivers full outside off, Nathan McSweeney pushes forward into the drive, but spears it straight to the cover fielder.
7.2: Suryansh Shedge offers width outside off, and Nathan McSweeney, perched outside his crease, slices a sumptuous drive through the gap between backward point and cover-point for four.
7.3: Suryansh Shedge lands it full outside off once more, Nathan McSweeney strides forward to drive, but hits it straight to backward point.
7.4: Suryansh Shedge digs it in short and wayward outside off, Nathan McSweeney wisely watches it sail past, and the umpire stretches the arms to signal a wide for height.
7.4: Dot ball from Suryansh Shedge to Nathan McSweeney.
7.5: Suryansh Shedge tosses it up outside off, and Nathan McSweeney strides forward to punch it crisply in front of mid-off for a sharp single.
7.6: Suryansh Shedge serves a full delivery angling back into off, and Liam Scott meets it with exquisite timing, driving straight down the ground as the ball races away to the boundary.
8.1: Anukul Roy extracts immediate grip from the surface, catching Nathan McSweeney's soft push to cover just short of the fielder.

8.3: Anukul Roy keeps it neat as Nathan McSweeney rotates the strike with a single out to long-off.
8.4: Anukul Roy fires it flat and on a good length right into the stumps, and Liam Scott steps back to punch it straight back to the bowler.

15.4: Nishant Sindhu goes wide of the crease and full on middle, allowing Nathan McSweeney to drive firmly down to long-off for a single.

16.4: Suryansh Shedge delivers the blow, extracting Nikhil Chaudhary courtesy of Anukul Roy in the deep as half the batting lineup tumbles.

19.4: Anukul Roy delivers, and Nathan McSweeney works this one away into the deep extra cover region for a single.
19.5: Anukul Roy drops it full on the pads, flicked away into the leg side as Patidar flings himself to his right at mid-wicket to claw it back and save the boundary.
19.6: Anukul Roy fires this final delivery very full into middle, and Nathan McSweeney lunges forward to push it down to long-off for a single.

20.2: A single to Nathan McSweeney off Vipraj Nigam.

20.4: Vipraj Nigam keeps it flat and on a good length, allowing Nathan McSweeney to drop back and punch it cleanly to sweeper cover for a single.
20.5: Vipraj Nigam darts another flat one into that channel outside off, and Will Sutherland rocks back to push it toward sweeper cover for one more.

21.2: No run for Sutherland off Yash Thakur.

21.4: Yash Thakur drops a slower off-cutter on a good length that grips and darts into Nathan McSweeney, rapping him high on the back-leg after the flick misses to save him from the lbw.

22.1: No run for Nathan McSweeney off Vipraj Nigam.
22.2: Vipraj Nigam tosses it up full outside off, and Nathan McSweeney strides forward to drive straight to cover without timing.
22.3: Vipraj Nigam loops this full delivery up just outside off, and Nathan McSweeney presses forward to punch a drive straight to cover, mirroring the exact stroke from the ball before.
22.4: Vipraj Nigam fires in a flat good length just outside off, forcing Nathan McSweeney back to pull toward mid-wicket for four dots in a row.
22.5: Vipraj Nigam tosses it up full on off, catching Nathan McSweeney's push in the air momentarily before it drops safely short of the bowler.

23.1: Yash Thakur delivers to Nathan McSweeney, who works it square of the wicket for a run.

23.3: Yash Thakur pitches it full on middle, prompting Nathan McSweeney forward to stroke a crisp drive that picks out mid-on precisely for a dot.

23.4: Yash Thakur probes the channel outside off, tempting Nathan McSweeney into the drive that flies thick off the edge, where Prabhsimran Singh hurls himself to his right, gets a hand to it, but puts down a tough chance before hitting the turf in agony, clutching his left leg.
23.5: Yash Thakur drops it full just outside off, Will Sutherland strides forward to drive, and bangs it straight to cover.
23.6: Yash Thakur fires it in on a good length tight to the off stump, and Sutherland drops his hands instantly for a sharp single driven into the covers.

Nathan McSweeney brings up a brilliant half-century, reaching 54 off 73 balls to keep his side ticking along nicely!

22.6: McSweeney darts it in quicker and flatter from round the wicket, allowing Shedge to work it away toward fine leg for one.
With INDA reeling at 112 for 5, AUSA are now all but certain to secure a dominant victory here!
23.1: Mahli Beardman digs it in short into the body, Suryansh Shedge gets hurried by the unexpected lift and nurdles it away toward backward square leg for a single.
23.2: Rajat Patidar finds the boundary off Mahli Beardman for four.
23.3: Mahli Beardman digs this one back of a length outside off, and Rajat Patidar softly dabs it down to third man for a single.
23.4: Mahli Beardman strikes as Suryansh Shedge holes out to Riley Meredith, perishing for 3 off 4 with a reckless stroke that leaves another wicket in the dust.
23.5: Mahli Beardman digs it in short at the stumps, forcing Vipraj Nigam to sway sharply out of the line.
23.6: Mahli Beardman slides in a pinpoint yorker on off, and Vipraj Nigam barely manages to scrape it away toward third man for a single.
24.1: Mitchell Owen sends it down to Vipraj Nigam, who works a single away toward third man.
24.2: Mitchell Owen drops it just a fraction shorter outside the off stump, and Rajat Patidar leans back smoothly to glide it down toward third man for a single.
24.3: Dot ball from Mitchell Owen to Vipraj Nigam.
24.4: Mitchell Owen delivers to Vipraj Nigam, punched with exquisite timing through extra cover for a crisp boundary.
24.5: Mitchell Owen floats it in from outside off, and Vipraj Nigam gets right behind the line, dead-batting it briskly toward the covers.
24.6: Mitchell Owen attacks the back of a length outside the off stump, and Vipraj Nigam watches it sail past, withholding any shot at the very last second.
25.1: No run for Rajat Patidar off Riley Meredith.
25.2: Riley Meredith digs it in short, Rajat Patidar swivels brilliantly to pull it into the deep square leg crowd, and the third umpire confirms it clears the rope for six!
25.3: Riley Meredith bangs it in again, catching Rajat Patidar on the body as it deflects away towards backward square leg for a leg bye.
25.4: Riley Meredith steams in, delivering it back of a length and angling sharply in, and Vipraj Nigam gets right behind it, dead-batting it firmly into the off-side.
25.5: No run for Vipraj Nigam off Riley Meredith.
25.6: No run for Vipraj Nigam off Riley Meredith.
26.1: Mitchell Owen steims in full and angling in, and Rajat Patidar strokes the drive cleanly away to wide mid-on for a single.
26.2: Mitchell Owen slides it up on off and Nigam leans into the drive, sending it cleanly out to sweeper cover for a single.
26.3: Mitchell Owen strays onto the pads with a loose delivery, and Patidar simply tickles it away as it races off to the fine leg boundary.
26.4: Mitchell Owen strikes with a sharp rising delivery on the body, forcing Rajat Patidar to pull off the higher part of the bat straight to Sam Konstas at deep mid-wicket for 53.
26.5: Mitchell Owen pitches this fuller on off stump, allowing Anukul Roy to punch it firmly towards sweeper cover to rotate the strike.
26.6: No run for Vipraj Nigam off Mitchell Owen.
27.1: Riley Meredith steams in from round the wicket, hurls it full and angling into the stumps, and Anukul Roy simply nudges it towards mid-on for a single.
27.2: No run for Vipraj Nigam off Riley Meredith.
27.3: Riley Meredith unleashes a sharp bouncer right into the stumps with genuine pace, leaving Vipraj Nigam swinging into empty air on the attempted upper cut.
27.4: Riley Meredith digs it in short once more, tempting Nigam into a risky single before a wise and rapid retreat halts the charge halfway down the track.
27.5: Riley Meredith offers width with a shortish delivery, and Vipraj Nigam climbs all over the bounce to flay it aerially past deep backward point for a crisp boundary.
27.6: No run for Vipraj Nigam off Riley Meredith.
28.1: Murphy floats this up invitingly on off stump, and Anukul Roy drills it straight back to the bowler.
28.2: Murphy takes pace right off this time, drawing Roy into a defensive prod straight into the pitch.
28.3: Murphy fires this in flatter and quicker, allowing Roy to punch it firmly away to sweeper cover for a single.
28.4: Murphy zips one through sharply on the pads, and Nigam works it away neatly toward backward square leg to rotate the strike.
28.5: Dot ball from Murphy to Anukul Roy.
28.6: Murphy drops it flatter and shorter, and Anukul Roy climbs tall to punch it firmly towards the covers.
29.1: Riley Meredith fires in a yorker length delivery on middle, and Vipraj Nigam solidly pushes it towards mid-off.
29.2: Riley Meredith sends down a pacy delivery that kicks off a length, beating Vipraj Nigam as he slashes hard close to his body.
29.3: Riley Meredith targets closer to the off-stump with a shortish delivery, and Vipraj Nigam completely misses his attempt at an upper glide.
29.4: Riley Meredith digs this in short at the body, and Vipraj Nigam simply pats it down safely into the off-side.
29.5: Riley Meredith bangs it in short once more, allowing Vipraj Nigam to dab it toward backward point and scamper through for a sharp single.
29.6: Riley Meredith serves it full and outside off, sliced away by Anukul Roy to deep backward point where a frantic dash for a second is cut short.
30.1: Murphy tosses it up and gets it turning away, allowing Roy to press forward and defend solidly.
30.2: Murphy fires it through quicker from round the wicket, forcing Roy back to push it towards point.
30.3: Murphy floats this one slower through the air, and Roy gets forward to defend it watchfully.
30.4: Murphy hurls it in, Anukul Roy pushes for a single, but a disastrous hesitation leaves him stranded as Mitchell Owen and Murphy combine to execute a catastrophic run out.
30.5: Murphy zips through a quicker ball outside off, and Nigam gets behind it to dead-bat it into the off-side.
30.6: Murphy strikes at the death, drawing the edge as Vipraj Nigam departs for 13 after a sharp catch by substitute Lachlan Shaw.
31.1: Arshad Khan does not score off Spencer Johnson.
31.2: Spencer Johnson bangs it back of a length angling in, and Arshad Khan stays back to dead-bat it into the pitch.
31.3: Spencer Johnson digs it in short with venom, and Arshad Khan wisely ducks underneath the sharp bouncer.
31.4: Spencer Johnson delivers a harmless length ball that Arshad Khan tamely chips to Mitchell Owen at covers, sealing a 125-run victory for Australia.

summary.text: Australia A won by 125 runs. AUSA made 274-10, Nathan McSweeney top-scoring with 123 off 135 balls; Suryansh Shedge took 4 for 40. INDA made 149-10, Rajat Patidar top-scoring with 53 off 51 balls; Mahli Beardman took 4 for 23.
